versions.subject: fix: Fix typo in selection
versions.detection:
selection_sddl_flag:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '-SecurityDescriptorSddl '
        - '-sd '
selection_set_service:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Set-Service '
        - 'D;;'
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - ';;;IU'
        - ';;;SU'
        - ';;;BA'
        - ';;;SY'
        - ';;;WD'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText IN ("*-SecurityDescriptorSddl *", "*-sd *") ScriptBlockText="*Set-Service *" ScriptBlockText="*D;;*" ScriptBlockText IN ("*;;;IU*", "*;;;SU*", "*;;;BA*", "*;;;SY*", "*;;;WD*")
